mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units, indicating strengthened consumer demand, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low unemployment (UNRATE < 5%) is associated with sustained economic growth, leading to consistently positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in low-unemployment periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 2% YoY and simultaneously, the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 3%, the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to balanced growth and accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: during late-cycle expansions, a rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a single month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors bet on sustained growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of triggered late-cycle instances, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate increased economic activity.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher in high-GDP-growth periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: when the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) drops below 1.5%, signaling aggressive monetary easing, the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: simultaneously low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and rising industrial production (INDPRO YoY growth > 1.5%) predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to a balanced economy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in post-shock recovery periods, a significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors bet on consumption-led recovery.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered post-shock instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.
